system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: agent1 = Agent("Agent1", llm_config, system_message="You are a helpful assistant.")
system_prompt_style.note: system_message supplied per agent/YAML config; rendered once per agent.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: PrimisAI Nexus is a powerful and flexible Python package for managing AI agents and coordinating complex tasks using LLMs.
env_context_strategy.note: No repository/environment context injection shipped; tools are user-supplied.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The `keep_history` parameter allows you to control whether an agent maintains conversation history between interactions.
context_compaction.note: Only full-history vs no-history toggle; no compaction mechanism documented.

observation_format.evidence_quote: All interactions, delegations, and tool usage are automatically logged and stored in the workflow directory
observation_format.note: Structured output schemas apply to agent responses, not observations.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: research_agent = Agent("Researcher", llm_config, tools=tools, system_message="You are a research assistant.", use_tools=True)
tool_call_format.note: Tools declared with metadata name/description, OpenAI-style function calling.

tool_count.note: Default agent ships no tools; tools are user-registered or MCP-discovered.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration**: Support for automatic discovery and usage of external tool servers via MCP, including SSE (HTTP) and stdio (local subprocess) transports.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: each agent follows a ReAct-style loop to process observations, perform internal reasoning, and act, such as by communicating with other agents or invoking external tools.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a single root Supervisor agent that acts as a global orchestrator, along with dedicated Task Supervisors distributed throughout the MAS structure.
planning_granularity.note: Planning is in supervisor free text; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: **Supervisor Class**: Manages multiple agents, coordinates tasks, and handles user interactions.
multi_agent_topology.note: Hierarchical with assistant supervisors reachable via config.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: let the supervisor manage the flow of information and task delegation.
delegation_mechanism.note: Supervisor delegates to pre-registered agents rather than spawning new ones.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Interactive Sessions**: Built-in support for interactive chat sessions with the AI system.
human_in_loop.note: Human interacts turn-by-turn in interactive session; no per-tool approval found.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: **Persistent History**: Built-in conversation history management with JSONL storage.

long_term_memory.note: JSONL history reloaded across runs; not a semantic memory store.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: You can restore any agent or supervisor's LLM-compatible context with a single call, enabling true warm starts and reproducibility, even for multi-level workflows.

self_verification.evidence_quote: When `strict=True`, responses are guaranteed to match the schema
self_verification.note: Only schema validation of outputs; no tests, linters or judge shipped.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: When `strict=False`, the agent attempts to follow the schema but falls back to unstructured responses if needed

rollback.evidence_quote: All interactions, delegations, and tool usage are automatically logged and stored in the workflow directory

termination_condition.note: Session ends on user/agent termination; no step or cost caps documented.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: **Flexible LLM Parameters**: Direct control over all language model parameters through configuration.
cost_controls.note: No budget, cache or router documented in the pinned README.

timeouts.evidence_quote: **Flexible Configuration**: Easy-to-use configuration options for language models and agents.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are Python functions executed in-process; MCP stdio servers run as local subprocesses.

filesystem_access.note: In-process Python tools have host filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Connect to any MCP-compatible HTTP server exposing tools via an SSE endpoint.

permission_model.note: No approval or allowlist layer over tool calls documented.

tracing.evidence_quote: **Integrated Logging**: Organized logging system within workflow structure.
tracing.note: history.jsonl also stores structured conversation records.

replayability.evidence_quote: preserving correct and replayable LLM state across runs.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: For a more detailed example of YAML configuration, check out the [task management example](examples/task_management_with_yaml).
eval_hooks.note: Benchmarks (HumanEval, VerilogEval) evaluated in the paper, no eval runner shipped.

guardrails.evidence_quote: When `strict=True`, responses are guaranteed to match the schema
guardrails.note: Schema validation of agent output; no action policies or input filters.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a lightweight Python framework designed to easily build and manage LLM-based MASs
target_domain.note: Evaluated on coding (HumanEval/VerilogEval), math and EDA tasks.

open_source.evidence_quote: We release the source code of this project on GitHub at https://github.com/PrimisAI/nexus under a permissive open-source license.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: agnostic of any particular LLM or application domain

first_release_date.note: No tag dates available in evidence; basis is paper v1 date.
